top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Slip as Oil Jump Fuels Fed-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary:
Stocks joined bonds lower as higher oil prices stoked worries about inflationary pressures, which were further bolstered by data showing jump in US business activity at the fastest pace since 2021.
Gargi Chaudhuri, Global Chief Investment Strategist at BlackRock, discusses the markets and how investors can be more selective amid a higher rate cycle. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Soybeans and Corn Are Slumping With Xi’s Arrival in US Awaited
top_signals.summary: Crop prices were dropping with no sales of American supplies reported to China so far this week ahead of Thursday’s summit between US President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Emerging Currencies Extend Decline on US Data, Strong Dollar
top_signals.summary:
Emerging-market currencies extended losses after the release of figures showing US business activity rose at the fastest pace in more than five years.
Bloomberg Intelligence Chief EM Strategist Damian Sassower discusses the US Dollar, EM opportunities, and China's economy ahead of Trump's meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitwise launches first Lighter ETP amid Hyperliquid rivalry
top_signals.summary: The product gives European investors brokerage access to the LIT token as Bitwise expands its lineup of products tied to decentralized derivatives platforms.
